items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did your father do? Brickmation. Oh, I see. And you? Brickmation.

ctx.x: What did your father do? Brickmation. Oh, I see. And you? Brickmation. Well, how did you get interested in music?

Well, I used to whistle a lot. You used to whistle a lot? I used to whistle a lot. And my niece of mine had a trumpet, and I picked it up on the heart, and we started playing, and I liked it. I went to lessons, and that's how I started it.
